title: 交换名片并介绍工作：姓名、职位与称呼
subtitle: 在职场社交中听懂对方身份，并用一句话介绍自己

audio.title: Business cards
audio.note: 官方音频总长约 1:42；本课已实际打开并连续播放核验 0:00–1:10（70 秒），覆盖前三段职业介绍。来源页提供完整 transcript。

sections.title: 1｜无字幕先听（5 分钟）
sections.body: 第一遍听 0:00–1:10，不暂停，只分辨有几位说话人、场合是否正式。第二遍记录姓名、职位或工作内容，以及谁使用了较短的英文名字。先不要看 transcript；回答后核对，再关文字重听。
questions: Peter 的博士专业是什么，他现在主要做什么工作？
Alessandro 在项目中是什么角色？Megumi 为什么工作时使用 Meg 这个名字？
sections.answers:
1. 电子工程博士；现在销售医疗设备。
2. Alessandro 是项目负责人；Megumi 认为外国人可能觉得她的本名难读，所以国际工作时使用 Meg。

sections.title: 2｜精听辨音、连读弱读与跟读（4 分钟）
sections.body:
精听三处：
1. “It's nice to meet you.”：to 弱读成 /tə/，meet you 连成一个节奏块。
2. “Please call me Peter.”：call me 连读，Peter 是重音，表示偏好的称呼。
3. “Here's my card.”：Here's /hɪəz/ 很短，my 弱，card 是信息重点。

每句先听 3 次 → 看文字跟读两遍 → 关文字影子跟读两遍 → 重听整个片段。注意正式但友好的语气。
sections.answers: 功能对应：Nice to meet you 用于初次见面；Please call me ... 告诉对方希望怎样称呼；Here's my card 递出名片。

sections.title: 3｜原创阅读（4 分钟）
sections.body: At a small industry event, Kevin met a product manager called Aiko. Kevin first read the name on her badge and asked how to pronounce it. Aiko smiled, said it slowly and added that international colleagues often called her Kay. Kevin repeated the name correctly before introducing himself. He explained that he worked in finance and helped small companies prepare reports. Aiko worked for a software company and managed products for business customers. They exchanged cards, but they did not immediately discuss sales. Instead, Kevin asked what kind of projects she enjoyed most. They discovered that both were interested in tools that saved office workers time. Before leaving, Aiko suggested connecting online. Kevin wrote one short note on her card so he would remember their conversation. A respectful name question and one genuine follow-up made the introduction useful and friendly.
questions: How did Kevin make sure he used Aiko's name correctly?
What shared interest did they discover?
sections.translation: 在一个小型行业活动中，凯文认识了一位叫爱子的产品经理。凯文先看她胸牌上的名字，并询问如何发音。爱子微笑着慢慢说了一遍，还补充说国际同事常叫她 Kay。凯文正确重复名字后才做自我介绍。他说自己在财务部门工作，帮助小企业编制报告。爱子在一家软件公司工作，负责面向企业客户的产品。他们交换了名片，但没有立刻谈销售。凯文转而问她最喜欢哪类项目。两人发现都对能节省办公室人员时间的工具感兴趣。离开前，爱子建议在网上保持联系。凯文在她的名片上写了一条简短备注，以便记住这次谈话。尊重地询问名字，再问一个真诚的后续问题，就能让介绍既有用又友好。
sections.answers:
1. He asked how to pronounce it and repeated it correctly.
2. Tools that save office workers time.

sections.title: 4｜词汇与高频词块（4 分钟）
sections.body:
1. It's nice to meet you.｜很高兴认识你。（高频词块）
It's nice to meet you, Ms Lee.｜很高兴认识你，李女士。
2. Please call me ...｜请叫我……（高频词块）
Please call me Alex.｜请叫我 Alex。
3. Here's my card.｜这是我的名片。（高频词块）
Here's my card with my email address.｜这是我的名片，上面有邮箱。
4. What do you do?｜你从事什么工作？（高频词块）
What do you do at your company?｜你在公司负责什么？
5. I work in ...｜我在……领域/部门工作。（高频词块）
I work in finance.｜我在财务部门工作。
6. I'm responsible for ...｜我负责……（高频词块）
I'm responsible for new products.｜我负责新产品。
7. Let's keep in touch.｜让我们保持联系。（高频词块）
It was great meeting you. Let's keep in touch.｜很高兴认识你，保持联系。
8. business card｜名片
I put her business card in my wallet.｜我把她的名片放进钱包。
9. pronounce｜发音
How do you pronounce your name?｜你的名字怎么读？

sections.title: 5｜语法：I work in / I work for / I work as（3 分钟）
sections.body:
work in 后接领域或部门；work for 后接公司；work as 后接职位。

例句：
1. I work in finance for Blue Water Ltd.｜我在蓝水公司的财务部门工作。
2. I work as a product manager.｜我是产品经理。

练习：
1. 填空：I work ___ an auditor.
2. 填空：She works ___ a software company ___ marketing.

sections.title: 6｜原创对话、替换与快速回应（3 分钟）
sections.body:
双人对话：
A: Hello, I'm Zhang. It's nice to meet you.
B: Nice to meet you too. I'm Katherine, but please call me Kate.
A: Thanks, Kate. What do you do?
B: I work as a product manager for a software company. And you?
A: I work in audit. I help companies check their financial reports.
B: That sounds interesting. Here's my card.
A: Thanks. Here's mine. Let's keep in touch.

替换练习：
1. product manager / software / audit → designer / medical equipment / finance。
2. Kate → Meg，并加入“名字怎样发音”的询问。

快速回应（5 秒内）：
1. 对方说 Please call me Ben：使用该称呼回应。
2. 对方问 What do you do：一句话说职位和职责。
3. 交换名片后：提出保持联系。

口头任务（30–60 秒）：在行业活动上介绍姓名、偏好称呼、公司、职位和职责，再问对方一个后续问题。
sections.answers: 参考：1. Nice to meet you, Ben. 2. I work in audit and check financial reports. 3. Thanks for your card. Let's keep in touch.

sections.title: 7｜复习上一课与反馈（1 分钟）
sections.body:
复习 3 个词块：
1. I'd love to come.｜我很愿意来。
2. What time does it start?｜几点开始？
3. Can I bring anything?｜我可以带什么吗？

各造一句。回原聊天告诉我第一遍听懂比例、最卡的姓名或职位句；也可发英文或语音完成自我介绍。只有实际收到并分析语音后，我才评价发音。
sections.answers: 自检：不看文字说出 Please call me ... / I work as ... / Here's my card。
